analysis.visual_description: A foul sheet on the board, the top drier than the tail. The chronicle is shut at the left, clear of the cat. No glass in the room.
On the board. Under the last speech a line is struck once. The quill slipped. The struck words can still be read. The right forefinger is inked.
On the board. The right margin, in a smaller hand, a cross beside it, empty paper under the cross.
On the board. Two new lines under the cross, then the pen set in the fold. Nothing below them.
